caption: The drawing depicts two main objects rendered in shades of gray and black, creating a monochromatic effect. On the left, there is a cylindrical metal canteen with a rounded shoulder and a threaded neck, as though it is missing its cap. The canteen has a visible horizontal seam about one-third from the top and appears to have dents or irregularities on its surface. To the right of the canteen, there is a matching cup lying on its side, shaped to fit over the bottom of the canteen. The inside of the cup is shaded more darkly, suggesting depth. The background is a plain, unadorned light beige color. Near the bottom right of the composition, the name “Charles Johnson” is written in cursive script.
title: Pewter Flask
